axes.concept: Operational project register: compare saved scene names, owners and true save states; open a row directly.
axes.layout: The fixed Pictures/Sempertex masthead and neutral horizontal route rule precede one continuous full-width register. Name/owner/state/Open share a desktop row. No preview sidebar; Taller keeps toolbar/rail/canvas/inspector.
axes.navigation: Direct row opening, name search and authorized owner selector in one toolbar; native account disclosure and Proyectos/Taller routes; contextual naming, copy and leave/load confirmations.
axes.typography: Existing Geist Sans only: 24px H1, 20px section title, compact 16px semibold project names, 14px actions, 12–13px metadata. Existing Geist Mono for numeric scene counts.
axes.density: One 28px-inset rounded sheet with 16px vertical desktop rows and 24px column gaps. Phone rows have 20px insets/vertical padding and a two-column owner/Open grouping; controls stay at least 44px high.
axes.components: Real installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input, Skeleton and Animate UI Dialog/AlertDialog; native selects/details and a custom semantic ruled list. Existing sibling radii/pill actions and ring-and-dot mark.
axes.colour: Unchanged Pictures globals.css palette in both themes: fondo/superficie/texto/acento; semantic success/warning/error only for real state. Existing texto-tenue aliases accessible control edges; no new palette.
axes.motion: Precise quick-cut registration: 360ms cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1), row stagger 28ms; route enters −8px, search −4px, paper +8px, rows +10px, status −5px, feedback −6px. Controls 150ms, plus press/focus/arrow and saving/skeleton feedback. Natural/subtle scale down; OS reduced/still removes motion.
